# Gossip frames

The gossip `Frame` enum (`crates/rdm-transport/src/membership.rs`): what travels on a mesh channel or the backbone, one postcard frame. Variants and fields are listed in declaration order, which is their postcard position. A field with a serde `with` module travels in that module's wire shape, so its Rust type is not followed. The workspace types the other fields carry follow, sorted by name.
